title: Detroit records for Clarence Blair's Fine Art label
summary: She recalls 1959 and 1962 Detroit records for Clarence Blair, who co-wrote her songs, and a trio he had her hire.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography
